intended_use.summary: After an owner-controlled free-credit account check, request validation only for the four exact approved Sentinel-1D RTC_GAMMA scene definitions in fixed event-first order; stop on the first failed or indeterminate response. No processing job, credit charge, product, or pixel action is requested.

sources.name: ASF HyP3 Basic exact-job validation endpoint

evidence.note: Basic API version 10.17.8 declares POST /jobs with explicit validate_only; the request schema admits S1D IW GRDH names and every frozen RTC option.

criteria.note: This identifies the Basic validation endpoint, not HyP3+ or a product asset.

evidence.note: ASF documents the Basic API and authenticated RTC job definitions.

criteria.note: ASF is the service operator and authoritative API publisher.

evidence.note: An Earthdata bearer token or approved owner session authenticates Basic requests.
The worker requires a passing own-account 240-free-credit check before any validate-only request and uses the Basic host only.

criteria.note: A documented route exists; actual account capacity, approved application status, and exact-scene acceptance remain runtime conditions. No paid path is allowed.

evidence.note: ASF documents authenticated POST /jobs and the Basic service interface.
Owner approved the conditional fixed-scene method and secret-safe account checks.
Owner declines retrieving the accepted agreement; this is not a product-rights waiver.

criteria.note: This pass applies only to validating the owner's own proposed job definitions without requested processing or output. It does not pass generated-product use, redistribution, terms acceptance by the agent, or publication.

evidence.note: The request loader hash-binds the exact four-scene candidate, proposal, bundle, approval, option set, and fixed order.

criteria.note: The resulting sanitized receipt retains source ID and a validation-only disposition, never raw account or job response.

evidence.note: Exact one-job validate_only request and response guards reject changed method, identity, cost over 60, execution state, and product files.
Generated-response tests cover fixed host, no redirect, sanitized output, stop on failure, and interruption.

criteria.note: An ambiguous or failed response stops the attempt; a live pass has not been observed.

evidence.note: Current public API schema and recent ASF source show validate_only flowing to dry_run and skipping credit decrement and persistent job writes.
The four exact public-catalog scene names and option definitions are fixed for the validation question.

criteria.note: The endpoint is fit to test scene eligibility and quote cost only. This pass is not a processing, output-rights, pixel, or map-fitness result.

evidence.note: Owner-controlled hidden credential or token input passes through an anonymous child pipe, never argv, environment, file, or chat.
Synthetic tests cover release-before-secret, secret omission from receipts, no redirect, and no automatic retry.

criteria.note: Fixed non-sensitive job names may be visible to the service; no raw account JSON, user ID, token, or response is recorded.

claim_boundary: This assessment supports a prospective bounded validate-only call under the existing owner envelope, after its separate implementation CI and final no-content preflight. It does not establish live account or exact-scene eligibility, no-charge behavior of the deployed service, product rights, or map fitness.
